patch.summary: Deputy cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Deputy pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 31-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.heading: Deputy cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Deputy against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 31-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, workforce scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Every user including managers is billed; list price invoice minimum. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Multi-location hourly operators who need scheduling + time + labor compliance requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Every user including managers is billed; list price invoice minimum
Side-by-side cost with Connecteam on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Every user including managers is billed; list price invoice minimum

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: HR, analytics, messaging, and US payroll are add-ons (some bundled on Pro)

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a restaurant-only suite or a core HRIS like BambooHR

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Deputy on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model hr spend with Deputy in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Deputy alongside category cost modelling.
